Summary: Primary production source frontend backed by Roslyn syntax and semantic analysis.

Capabilities.Details: Roslyn semantic model and syntax fallback are available.
NUnit and xUnit-style test and setup methods are recognized through the legacy C# parser; MSTest should be treated as detected/unsupported until mapped and verified.
Common Selenium actions are recognized and lowered into legacy/IR V2 actions.
Selenium By locators, POM properties, table/list mappings, raw expressions and unresolved targets are represented with diagnostics.
Explicit waits, project wait helpers and configured wait policies are supported.
NUnit/FluentAssertions/basic assertion shapes are recognized through existing recognizers.
C# Selenium POM/project adapter mappings are the richest supported path.
Source-specific adapter config and helper semantics are fully supported.

Limitations: Generated correctness still depends on source-backed adapter mappings for project-specific helpers/POMs.
Reflection/dynamic invocation and highly indirect helper flows may still require manual TODO review.
RecommendedValidation: Run dump-ir with legacy and v2 output before renderer refactors.
Use strict/production config validation when targeting TypeScript.
